CODE
2.3.4. 
Minors
If the Family Court has granted an age waiver for the conclusion of the marriage, a minor may also choose a matrimonial property regime or change that choice before the conclusion of the marriage, if he is assisted by his father and mother or one of them or, failing that, with the authorisation of the Family Court.
The minor may also, subject to such assistance or authorisation, change his matrimonial property regime during the marriage.
